Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling straight along its lane at a steady speed of 30 kph, while the cyclist is crossing far ahead in the left lateral direction (at $x \approx 25.8$ m, $y \approx -5$ m moving towards positive $y$). Since the cyclist is well ahead and not currently obstructing the ego's immediate path, maintaining the current trajectory and speed (A0) is appropriate.
